raw.title: Director, Marketing Technology & Campaign Operations
raw.excerpt: At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change.
raw.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.


If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you.


Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Director, Marketing Technology & Campaign Operations to be a part of making this happen.


About the Role

The Director, Marketing Technology & Campaign Operations owns the technology, data, and operational engine that powers Arctic Wolf’s global marketing organization — from the marketing technology (MarTech) stack and artificial intelligence (AI) roadmap through the campaign operations execution that turns strategy into delivered programs. This role sits on the Growth Services and Operations leadership team and reports directly to the VP, Growth Services and Operations.


This leader owns the marketing technology ecosystem end to end, including Marketo administration, the broader go-to-market (GTM) technology stack, data architecture and governance, and the effort to embed AI into the team’s core workflows. The role also owns the operational engine that delivers campaigns on behalf of the teams that own strategy and pipeline targets, including Acquisition Marketing, Partner Marketing, Customer Marketing, and demand generation. This is a services and execution role for campaigns — it exists so the teams setting demand strategy have one reliable partner who builds, launches, and runs their programs to a high standard, on time, and within budget. Account-based marketing, pipeline acceleration and reengagement, and creative campaign programs sit outside this role's scope and remain owned by other teams.


This leader owns campaign execution across email, webinar, direct mail, and content syndication across the NAM (North America), EMEA (Europe, the Middle East, and Africa), and APAC (Asia-Pacific) regions and Arctic Wolf’s sales plays, including the intake model, service level agreements (SLAs), build and QA standards, and the budget and MDF (market development funds) administration that keep the broader marketing organization moving without becoming a bottleneck.


This is a people-leadership-heavy role, managing a distributed team that spans marketing technology, database management, email and nurture strategy, and campaign operations, and a close partner to the Senior Director, Campaigns and Content and the teams that own demand and pipeline targets.


Responsibilities


Marketing Technology Strategy & Architecture

  • Own the strategy, architecture, and performance of the marketing technology ecosystem, including Marketo administration, governance, and configuration.
  • Build and maintain a rolling 12- to 18-month technology roadmap aligned to company growth goals and GTM strategy.
  • Own vendor selection, contract negotiation, and renewal decisions for MarTech tools, including intent and enrichment platforms, AI data layers, and integration platform as a service (iPaaS) tools.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and vendors and recommend the highest-return investments.
  • Set up, manage, and troubleshoot integrations across the stack, including with Salesforce and other core business systems.

Embedding AI Into Marketing Operations

  • Lead the strategy and execution for embedding AI into the marketing technology stack and daily team workflows.
  • Identify and operationalize AI use cases that make marketers and sales development representatives (SDRs) more effective and efficient.
  • Own measurable outcomes tied to AI adoption, including cycle-time reduction and process automation, and report progress to leadership.
  • Stay ahead of MarTech and AI trends to keep Arctic Wolf’s stack modern and competitive.

Data, Lifecycle & Reporting Infrastructure

  • Own database strategy, lifecycle-stage design, lead scoring, and routing architecture in partnership with the marketing technology and database management team.
  • Own the data and reporting infrastructure that supports campaign attribution, sales-play performance, and pipeline reporting.
  • Establish data governance and compliance practices (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) that maintain accuracy and consistency across marketing systems.
  • Ensure the technology stack is configured for scale, security, compliance, and operational excellence.

Campaign Operations Leadership & Execution Excellence

  • Own the end-to-end campaign operations model across email, webinar (ON24), direct mail (Sendoso), content syndication, and list management, in partnership with the Campaigns and Content team.
  • Own the intake model, SLAs, prioritization, and operating cadence that campaign requests move through, including email rules of engagement.
  • Ensure consistent build quality, tracking, and attribution setup in Marketo and Salesforce across the NAM, EMEA, and APAC regions and sales plays.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to standardize and automate recurring campaign work.

Marketing Investment Planning & Budget Governance

  • Partner with the Revenue and Growth Leadership Team to develop the annual marketing budget, aligning spend with strategic growth priorities and pipeline targets.
  • Implement processes and controls to track, approve, and reconcile spend, ensuring budget discipline, transparency, and alignment with corporate finance practices.
  • Own budget and MDF administration for the team, including AWS Partner Funding requests, claims, and invoicing.

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop a distributed team spanning marketing technology, database management, email and nurture strategy, and campaign operations.
  • Set clear priorities, SLAs, operating rhythms, and development plans, including a generalist coverage model so aligned stakeholders never lose a point of contact.
  • Build a culture of technical rigor, execution excellence, and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary execution partner to Acquisition Marketing, Partner Marketing, Customer Marketing, and demand generation for their campaign programs.
  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to Business Applications and IT, resolving dependencies on routing, scoring, and lifecycle triggers.
  • Partner with the Senior Director, Campaigns and Content on campaign calendar, briefs, and content activation.
  • Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, and Finance on shared infrastructure, budget, and vendor decisions.
  • Represent marketing technology and campaign operations priorities in Growth Services and Operations leadership planning.

Who You Are​

  • You are a hands-on technical leader who understands marketing technology architecture at a deep level, and you can run a high-volume campaign execution engine at the same time.
  • You see AI as a practical tool for reducing manual work, not a buzzword, and you can identify where it will actually move the needle.
  • You build scalable processes, SLAs, and governance rather than absorbing chaos into your own schedule.
  • You can manage a distributed, regionally diverse team across both technology and execution disciplines and keep them focused on outcomes, not just tickets.
  • You don’t need to own the pipeline number to care about it — you measure yourself by how well you deliver for the teams who do.
  • You are comfortable owning a roadmap, a budget, and a vendor negotiation, and just as comfortable being hands-on in the platform or the campaign build when needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in marketing technology, marketing operations, campaign operations, or demand generation, including 3+ years of people leadership.
  • Hands-on experience with Marketo (or a comparable marketing automation platform) administration and Salesforce.
  • Experience building and owning a marketing technology roadmap, including vendor evaluation, integration management, and stack governance.
  • Experience managing multi-channel campaign execution, such as email, webinar, and direct mail, at scale.
  • Experience identifying and operationalizing AI or automation use cases within marketing or revenue operations workflows.
  • Experience managing distributed or global teams.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect marketing technology and campaign investments to revenue outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in cybersecurity, software as a service (SaaS), or another complex business-to-business (B2B) industry.
  • Experience managing a team spanning multiple regions, such as NAM, EMEA, and APAC.
  • Marketo certification or an equivalent platform certification.
  • Experience with intent or data enrichment tooling, such as 6sense, ZoomInfo, or Clay.
  • Experience administering a marketing budget or MDF program.

Travel Requirements

Typically 10% or less of business travel.


On-Camera Policy

  • To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews.
  • Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers.
  • We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.


Our Values 

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.


We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.


We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.


All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

  • Equity for all employees
  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days
  • 401k match
  • Training and career development programs
  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services
  • Fertility support and paid parental leave

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing . View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.


Security Requirements

  • Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies).
  • Background checks are required for this position.
  • This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations.
The base salary range for this job family is 135,200 to 266,400 USD annually. This range reflects the base pay the company reasonably expects to offer for this position, aligned to the broader job family base pay structure. Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level. In addition to base pay, Arctic Wolf offers variable incentive compensation, new hire equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

raw.description:
The Relationship Manager (RM) serves as the primary point of contact for high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) private risk management clients. The RM is responsible for delivering elite, personalized client service, providing technical expertise in personal lines insurance, and proactively managing complex risk exposures across a sophisticated book of business. This role operates at the intersection of client advocacy, carrier relationship management, and strategic risk consulting — and is critical to driving retention, satisfaction, and growth within the Private Risk Management (PRM) practice.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Service & Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned book of HNW/UHNW clients, delivering proactive, white-glove service across all touchpoints — phone, email, and in-person.
  • Anticipate client needs and surface coverage recommendations, risk alerts, and market changes before clients ask.
  • Conduct annual interactive client reviews, presenting renewal proposals and agendas that reflect a deep understanding of each client's exposures and lifestyle.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships that drive long-term retention and organic growth through referrals.

Risk Analysis & Coverage Consulting

  • Review client exposures, underwriting memos, loss experience, and current coverages to identify gaps and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Advise and counsel clients on complex risk exposures including high-value homes, fine art and collectibles, watercraft, aircraft, excess liability/umbrella, and specialty lines.
  • Review inspection reports for coverage accuracy and potential loss prevention issues; provide proactive direction to resolve outstanding items and minimize E&O exposure.
  • Remain current on industry offerings, carrier appetite changes, and HNW market trends — making proactive recommendations to clients and leadership.
  • Understand and introduce the holistic Baldwin platform as appropriate, including employee benefits, commercial lines, and asset protection services.

Market Placement & Carrier Relations

  • Act as a market placement specialist, remarketing existing programs as needed to ensure competitive positioning and alignment with client needs.
  • Cultivate strong relationships with carrier partners including PURE, Chubb, AIG Private Client, Cincinnati, Berkley One and specialty markets.
  • Maintain thorough knowledge of insurer contracts, underwriting guidelines, proprietary systems, and appetite to optimize placement decisions.
  • Collaborate with carrier representatives to advocate for favorable outcomes on complex risks, renewals, and claims.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Maintain accuracy, timeliness, and completeness in all client and carrier interactions to minimize errors and omissions exposure.
  • Ensure all policy activity — new business, renewals, endorsements, cancellations — is documented accurately in agency management systems (Epic preferred).
  • Adhere to Baldwin's established workflows, service standards, and compliance requirements across all client interactions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and the overall client experience; surface recommendations to leadership.
  • Manage a high-volume workload with strong organizational discipline and attention to detail.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

Required Qualifications

  • Active Property & Casualty insurance license in the state(s) where business is conducted, or the ability to obtain all required licenses within 90 days of hire.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in personal lines insurance, with demonstrated knowledge of HNW carrier contracts, underwriting guidelines, and claims processes.
  • Proven ability to manage complex client relationships with a high degree of professionalism, responsiveness, and discretion.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to sophisticated clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and agency management systems; experience with Epic highly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Risk Management, Finance, or a related field preferred.
  • Professional designations strongly preferred: CPRIA (Chartered Private Risk and Insurance Advisor), CPCU, CAPI, CPRM, CIC, or equivalent.
  • Prior experience working with UHNW clients, family offices, or within a dedicated private client/PRM practice.
  • Familiarity with specialty lines including fine art, jewelry, watercraft, aviation, and excess/umbrella liability.

CORE COMPETENCIES

What We Look For

  • Client Obsession — You treat every client interaction as an opportunity to exceed expectations and build loyalty.
  • Technical Depth — You bring genuine expertise in HNW personal lines and can translate complex coverage concepts into clear client guidance.
  • Ownership Mentality — You manage your book like a business — tracking details, anticipating renewals, and driving outcomes without waiting to be asked.
  • Collaborative Spirit — You partner effectively with, advisors, insurers, and leadership to deliver seamless client experiences.
  • Continuous Improvement — You actively look for ways to sharpen your skills, improve processes, and contribute to the growth of the PRM practice.

ABOUT THE BALDWIN GROUP

Why Baldwin PRM

The Baldwin Group (NASDAQ: BWIN) is a leading insurance brokerage and risk management firm committed to delivering innovative solutions for individuals, families, and businesses. Our Private Risk Management practice serves high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients with a concierge-level approach to personal risk — backed by deep carrier relationships, market expertise, and a team that genuinely cares about client outcomes.

Baldwin offers a collaborative, growth-oriented environment where colleagues are empowered to build meaningful careers while making a real impact for the clients they serve.

The starting pay is $85,000 salary. Salary is negotiable upon time of offer.

The Clinical Systems Study Build Specialist will be responsible for the creation and maintenance of financial study builds in the Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) for the Alcanza Clinical Research site network. The Department of Neurology is seeking a Compliance Monitoring Specialistfor the BIOS division in the School of Medicine. This position ensures quality, accuracy, and integrity of multi-center clinical trial data through risk-based remote monitoring and compliance oversight, supporting BIOS CTCC’s mission to advance neurological research. The Compliance Monitoring Specialist is responsible for conducting compliance monitoring reviews of clinical research trials in keeping with established policies and procedures.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

  • Schedule compliance monitoring visits with research study staff.
  • Develop protocol specific forms.
  • Review research and medical records against clinical protocols for compliance.
  • Prepare written summary of compliance review results.
  • Meet with principal investigators and data support staff to review compliance results.
  • Follow-up on results, as necessary.
  • Maintain scheduling and review information in OnCore for all protocol reviews.
  • Help study staff to prepare for external audits.
  • Participate in unscheduled internal reviews and compliance monitoring reviews at affiliate institutions as needed.
  • Schedule compliance monitoring visits with research study staff to monitor data integrity studies.
  • Generate queries and conduct follow-up for non-compliance issues.
  • Generate monitoring summary reports and communicate these findings.
  • Provide support for monitored trials in the form of research into regulations and review of protocols and Case report templates for protocol staff.
  • Assist staff in developing corrective actions for compliance review observations when appropriate.
  • Assist in training new research staff regarding research compliance; may make presentations to support this effort.
  • Participate on subcommittees by reviewing new studies for quality assurance and general content, and coding new studies.
  • Prepare reviews of studies by various committees.
  • Attend and participate in monthly meetings.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of SOPs for the research manual on assigned areas website as needed.
  • Perform periodic compliance reviews.
  • Other duties as assigned.

In addition to the duties above

  • Conducts routine monitoring visits (remote and on-site) using established tools and checklists and documents findings.
  • Assists with preparing studies and documentation for internal and external audits and inspections.
  • Tracks and follows up on identified findings to support timely resolution and compliance improvement.
  • Supports maintenance of monitoring trackers, logs, and reporting tools to ensure audit readiness.


Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Three years of related experience with clinical trials/medical research.
  • Eligible for certification by a professional organization in human subjects research.
  • Additional education may substitute for required experience and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.

Cupix’s cloud-based software platform and mobile capture app create the easiest possible way of 360 immersive photo-documentation and progress tracking of physical spaces, providing spatial intelligence to remote teams and facilitating actionable insights. Our products digitally disrupt several industries, including construction, architecture design, and facility management.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for owning a regional territory and applying an understanding of Cupix’s products, sales methodology, processes, qualification techniques, and customer base while selling to strategic account with a focus on companies that can benefit our world class 3D digital twin software for the construction, architecture design, BIM/VDC, and facility management industries. The primary function of this position is to acquire new accounts and upsell or cross-sell leveraging existing accounts in your target territory.

You will be reporting to the VP of Sales. Cupix is obsessed with developing our team and helping them take the next step in their career.

To be successful in this role, you’ll perform the following:

  • Working from your virtual office, develop a deep understanding of Cupix’s products, value proposition, competitive advantages, and industries served, with a demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts and technology to a variety of audiences.
  • Develop sales plans for territory development to build rapport and create and win opportunities.
  • Network within your assigned territory / region, and travel as needed to customer sites. ● Provide sales management with reports on sales activities and projects as requested forecasts.
  • Manage and maintain accurate contacts, accounts, and opportunity information within our CRM system (Salesforce).
  • Achieve or exceed monthly and quarterly targets
  • Obtain repeat business, referrals, and references by applying the understanding of the unique requirements of your customers
  • Approach all deals with a customer-focused mentality and a long-term consultative approach.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with key internal partners such as BDR, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Accounting, and Legal.

Your Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 6+ years of demonstrated successful software sales, preferably with B2B software companies focusing on architectural design, construction, facility management, or the 3D reality capture industry.
  • Ability to develop trusted relationships.
  • Experience at a high-growth startup is a plus.
  • Proven ability to develop and manage pipeline and forecasting.
  • Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce).
  • Highly organized, with strong attention to detail.
  • Analytically driven with the ability to understand the difference between interesting and actionable data.
  • Collaborative team player and self-starter.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities at the same time.
  • Growth mindset - desire to continue to improve, simplify, scale new and existing processes, and professional growth.
  • Intellectual curiosity and creativity in solving unique problems.
  • Strong familiarity with construction technology, specifically Building Information Management (BIM)
  • MEDDPICC Sales Methodologies

About Cupix

Cupix is a VC-backed fast-growing startup providing machine-vision based, end-to-end, SaaS products that can transform 360 photos taken by off-the-shelf 360 cameras to a virtual 3D space. Our products are being used by tens of thousands of users, including professional photographers, real-estate brokers, construction jobsite managers, and facility security officers worldwide. We have three offices in the Silicon Valley bay area, Dallas, TX, and Seoul, Korea.

Travel Requirements

Under 50%

No Relocation Provided

EEO Statement

Cupix Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

über ]init[

Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.

deine mission bei ]init[

Du willst Digitalisierung dort vorantreiben, wo sie gesellschaftlich wirklich zählt? das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium bildet die fachliche Grundlage für deine Tätigkeit bei uns.
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit.

das bieten wir dir

werde teil des teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

raw.excerpt: About The RoleWe are seeking a hands-on, strategic, and analytically driven Director of Compensation to lead the design and execution of enterprise-wide compensation strategy.
raw.description:
About The Role

We are seeking a hands-on, strategic, and analytically driven Director of Compensation to lead the design and execution of enterprise-wide compensation strategy. This includes developing and driving all aspects of Compensation, equity-based programs, variable pay, bonuses, and ensuring that our functional programs support our diverse enterprise workforce.

In this critical leadership role, you will own the end-to-end strategy for compensation across base pay, equity, variable pay, bonuses, and performance-based incentive structures—ensuring alignment with business priorities, market competitiveness, and scalable growth. A core focus will be building differentiated reward frameworks that directly drive performance and improve retention across Tech, Sales, Retail, and Operations.

You will partner closely with HR, Finance, Sales, Retail, Operations, Tech and Executive Leadership to architect compensation and rewards strategies that translate business objectives into measurable behaviors and outcomes. This includes developing innovative incentive models that motivate high performance, strengthen frontline engagement, and support a diverse, enterprise-scale workforce.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience building and scaling compensation programs in complex organizations, with a track record of modernizing reward structures to improve performance and retention. Experience with executive compensation design and administration is highly desirable, along with exposure to public company environments and governance frameworks.
You are equally comfortable operating strategically at the executive level and executing in a highly hands-on capacity. Familiarity with leveraging AI-enabled tools to enhance compensation analytics, modeling, and operational efficiency is strongly preferred.

You bring strong leadership, executive communication skills, and project management discipline, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where compensation strategy is a key driver of business success.

What You Get To Do Every Day

  • Evaluate current-state compensation programs, structures, in light of a fast-moving environment and evolving macro-environment.

  • Assess and prepare for future-state needs and recommend data-driven enhancements enterprise wide.

  • In partnership with the VP, Total Rewards, own and evolve our compensation strategy in alignment with business priorities.

  • Innovate and introduce AI tools and process approaches into our compensation department that enable greater productively and/or better outcomes.

  • Lead compensation market analyses across the organization to ensure competitive market pricing and internal equity, informing compensation and benefits decisions.

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to benchmark roles and design competitive total rewards packages.

  • Lead the annual rewards cycle, including merit and promotion reviews, in close partnership with FP&A on budget modeling.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and consultant to business leaders on the company's total rewards philosophy.

What You Bring To The Role

Minimum Requirements:

  • 7+ years of progressive compensation experience with increasing scope and responsibility, including leadership of enterprise compensation strategy and execution.

  • Proven track record of designing, implementing, and scaling impactful compensation, incentive, and retention programs in high-growth environments, with a strong focus on sales operations and retail organizations.

  • Deep expertise in sales compensation design, including incentive plan architecture, and performance-based reward structures strongly preferred.

  • Experience in executive compensation design and administration strongly preferred.

  • Experience in public company environments, including exposure to compensation committee processes, governance frameworks, and regulatory considerations strongly preferred.

  • Experience in high-growth environments, including B2C, retail, or sales-led B2B organizations, with demonstrated ability to scale compensation programs in fast-paced, evolving business models preferred.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to lead multiple complex, cross-functional workstreams simultaneously.

  • Strong analytical skills with expertise in data modeling, forecasting, and compensation metrics to drive insights and decision-making.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence and align cross-functional partners and executive leadership.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while managing multiple competing priorities with strong organizational discipline.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing business needs and priorities.

  • Highly motivated self-starter with a strong sense of urgency and ability to deliver high-quality work under pressure.

  • Strong ability to develop and mentor talent

  • Ability to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field.

  • Deep experience in sales compensation design, including incentive plan architecture, quota setting, and performance-based reward structures strongly preferred.

  • Experience in executive compensation design and administration strongly preferred.

  • Experience in public company environments, including exposure to governance, compensation committee processes, and regulatory considerations, strongly preferred.

  • Experience in high-growth environments, including B2C, retail, or sales-led B2B organizations, with exposure to scaling compensation programs in fast-moving, evolving business models preferred.

Compensation, Benefits, + Perks

The expected salary range for this role is $195,000.00-$235,000.00. To determine starting pay we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location and an evaluation of a candidate’s skills, experience, market demands, and internal parity. Additionally, salary is just one component of TRR’s total rewards package. Depending on role, employees may also be eligible for a bonus program, incentive pay and benefits.

The RealReal is the world’s largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods, with 40 million members. With a rigorous authentication process overseen by experts, The RealReal provides a safe and reliable platform for consumers to buy and sell their luxury items. We have hundreds of in-house gemologists, horologists, and brand authenticators who inspect thousands of items each day. As a sustainable company, we give new life to pieces by thousands of brands across numerous categories—including women's and men's fashion, fine jewelry and watches, art, and home—in support of the circular economy. We make selling effortless with free virtual appointments, in-home pickup, drop-off, and direct shipping. We handle all of the work for consignors, including authenticating, using AI and machine learning to determine optimal pricing, photographing and listing their items, as well as shipping and customer service.


The RealReal is committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or Veteran status. We will consider qualified applicants for a position regardless of arrest or conviction records. At TRR, People Come First. That’s why diversity and inclusion are vital to our priorities as an equal opportunity employer. You can read about our Diversity Equity and Inclusion program here.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Career Category

Job Description

  • 高级生物医药代表/生物医药代表

基本要求

  • 具有医学、药学或相关专业大学专科及以上学历；
  • 掌握所推广药品的药理毒理、功能主治或适应症、联合用药、不良反应、禁忌症和注意事项等知识；
  • 经公司培训并考核合格；
  • 不得存在法律法规禁止从事医药代表工作的情形。

1. 计划管理（Planning & Execution）

  • 与直线经理及相关团队协作，根据区域及客户需求制定并执行药品学术推广计划；
  • 合理安排客户拜访、学术交流及相关推广活动；
  • 定期回顾工作进展，持续优化工作计划及执行效果。

2. 药品学术推广与客户互动（Academic Promotion & Customer Engagement）

根据《医药代表管理办法》开展药品学术推广活动，主要包括向关键医疗卫生机构工作人员：

  • 传递药品相关信息；
  • 沟通并协助合理使用药品；
  • 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息；
  • 开展专业客户拜访、学术交流及疾病教育活动，支持医疗卫生专业人士对产品及疾病领域信息的了解和认知。
  • 通过向医疗卫生专业人士传递药品相关信息，开展专业沟通与学术支持，协助医疗机构合理使用药品以支持渠道覆盖及业务运营顺畅

3. 客户洞察与信息反馈（Insight Generation & Feedback）

  • 建立并维护与医疗卫生专业人士的专业沟通渠道；
  • 了解客户学术需求、临床实践需求及市场动态；
  • 及时收集、分析并反馈客户意见、市场信息及业务相关洞察；
  • 为学术推广活动及业务决策提供支持。

4. 资源整合与团队协作（Collaboration & Resource Coordination）

  • 与市场、医学、商务及其他相关团队保持紧密合作，共同支持学术推广活动开展；
  • 参与学术会议、专业项目及相关活动的组织与执行；
  • 主动分享经验与最佳实践，促进团队协作与共同成长。

5. 专业发展与合规管理（Professional Development & Compliance）

  • 持续提升产品知识、疾病领域知识及专业推广能力；
  • 如实、准确地传递药品相关信息，确保学术推广内容的科学性和准确性；
  • 按合理业务需求和公司规定，合理制定药品学术推广活动计划并管理活动预算，确保会议真实，合理，符合政策要求；
  • 完成公司要求的培训及能力认证。

严格遵守国家法律法规（包括但不限于《医药代表管理办法》）以及公司各项政策要求。

raw.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Description

Vantage is looking for a driven Director, Electrical Engineering to provide overall leadership for our development of data center space for current and future projects.  This position will oversee the electrical aspect of new product development, new industry design trends, innovations, changes in code requirements and all aspects of Design Engineering.  As a leader, you will be responsible for managing a team with multiple projects related and product development tasks with competing priorities ensuring all projects are in alignment with strategic corporate objectives.  Collaboration and integration in the sales lifecycle process including client interface is integral to the role.  Constant communication with facilities operation, sales and marketing department and other subject matter experts will ensure that the design of new facilities will maintain and enhance Vantage’s product and service offering. 

Essential Job Functions

Strategic Leadership

  • Define and drive the vision for design and engineering initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and industry best practices.

  • Lead strategic planning for engineering projects, balancing innovation with operational excellence.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and design methodologies to enhance enterprise value and maintain competitive advantage.

  • Represent the organization in industry forums and maintain strong engagement with the data center engineering community to stay ahead of trends.

Influence & Collaboration

  • Build strong relationships across internal teams (Delivery, Mission Critical Operation, Market Development, Sales) and external stakeholders (Consultants, Vendors, Contractors).

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, providing insights that influence business strategy and product development.

  • Foster a culture of collaboration and innovation through initiatives like the “Employee Think Tank,” ensuring ideas are heard and acted upon.

  • Communicate effectively with department leadership through reports and presentations that drive informed decision-making.

Autonomy & Decision-Making

  • Exercise independent judgment in managing engineering activities from concept through commissioning across the portfolio.

  • Drive design and engineering decisions to conclusion, balancing technical requirements, budget constraints, and business priorities.

  • Oversee consultant/vendor qualification and make recommendations for technology adoption and deployment.

  • Ensure lessons learned are integrated into processes to promote continuous improvement.

Managerial Capacity

  • Provide thought leadership and accountability for team performance, budget, and schedule adherence.

  • Oversee QA/QC processes, while mentoring and developing engineering staff, fostering professional growth and technical excellence.

  • Manage team workload effectively to maintain balance, drive efficiency while ensuring timely delivery of high-quality work products.

  • Recruit, lead, and manage high-performing Electrical SME team – driving collaboration, accountability, and delivering excellence.

    Nature of Work

    • Lead all aspects ofElectricalDesign and Engineering, including site assessment, conceptual design, basis of design, scope of work, and development of construction documents.

    • Oversee inputs and deliverables to guarantee that new data center spaces meet all applicable requirements (BOD, specifications, codes, leases, etc.), while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and added value.

    • Develop and refine design standards to align with company vision and industry benchmarks.

    • Coordinate with site operations to define project requirements and design criteria and provide support for any issues that arise once critical infrastructure is in operation

    • Work with sales and marketing to provide technical support wherever needed

    • Stay abreast of new technologies and opportunities to innovate within and beyond the data center industry.

    Additional Responsibilities

    • Develop and manage content for team learning and onboarding, promoting transparency and two-way communication across the organization.

    • Additional duties as assigned by ManagementJob Requirements

    Education:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

    • Registration as a US-based Professional Engineer (P.E.) strongly preferred.

    Experience:

    • 8+ years of experience in an engineering management or leadership role required.

    • 15+ years of experience in electrical design and construction required,20+ years preferred

    • Data Center experience is required.

    • Extensive experience in leading technical design teams including:

    • Cross-discipline knowledge and understanding, including Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architectural, and other critical data center trades

    • Strong understanding of the design, construction, commissioning, and operations processes for North American development projects

    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

    • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem solving ability

    • Demonstrated experience leading and developing electrical engineering teams.

    • Experience managing a multi-project engineering workload in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

    • Strong knowledge of electrical distribution systems, utility services, substations, medium-voltage and low-voltage systems, emergency and standby power systems, UPS systems, generators, transformers, switchgear, protection and controls, grounding, and electrical monitoring systems.

raw.excerpt: Company Overview Gigawatt is building the AI-native software that runs America’s utilities — a modern, agentic suite spanning customer, revenue, service, and procurement operations.
raw.description:
Company Overview

Gigawatt is building the AI-native software that runs America’s utilities — a modern, agentic suite spanning customer, revenue, service, and procurement operations. We are live with our first major utility customer and scaling fast. Learn more at .

Job Summary

Gigawatt is building the modern system of record for electric utilities — billing, revenue, customer, and operations — on an AI-forward platform. Configuration Analysts work with the utility's core team to analyze its business rules and turn them into a live, validated product — taking real tariffs, rate schedules, special contracts, and riders, decomposing them, and configuring them in the Gigawatt platform so the customer's bills come out right, to the penny.

You own each unit from requirements through validated sign-off, using an AI-accelerated workflow (our configuration “flywheel”) rather than doing it by hand. This is a hands-on configuration role with real analytical depth — it is not a software-engineering role, and not a pure business-analysis role; you understand the requirements and build them into the system.

You'll configure the system of record for a major utility from the ground up, with AI doing the heavy lifting so you focus on judgment — not a back-office admin seat maintaining someone else's setup. It's a lean, senior, AI-accelerated team building a function that will scale across the utility industry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run the end-to-end configuration loop for each unit (party, premise, account, tariff, special contract, rider, etc.): intake and source collection → decompose and analyze → author the per-object configuration guide → configure in the platform in dependency order → hand to QA for parallel-bill validation → sign-off and promote.
  • Decompose complex business rules, tariffs (aka rate schedules), and special contracts into the platform's configuration model using our authoring guides and reusable component library — referencing shared components rather than re-inventing them.
  • Drive the AI-assisted configuration flywheel: prep source documents for the LLM parse, review AI-generated price tables, seasonal schedules, and charge formulas, apply human-in-the-loop judgment where confidence is low, and feed corrections back to improve the tooling.
  • Partner with the module Solution Architect on model-fit and data-model questions, and with the client's rate/billing SMEs to confirm source-of-truth and unique requirements.
  • Own configuration quality: your tariff and rate configuration passes parallel-bill-to-the-penny validation against 12–13 months of billed history from a legacy CIS.
  • Keep the configuration guide, workbook, and component library in sync, and document hand-offs.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Configuration / rules-engine experience: you've configured an enterprise platform declaratively (utility CIS/billing such as Oracle CC&B or SAP IS-U); minimum of 5 years
  • Domain fluency: utility rate/tariff/billing structures, or transferable rate/pricing/benefits-rules experience is a must
  • Analytical + technical comfort: you read a tariff filing or contract and see the underlying data model; comfortable with structured data, spreadsheets, light SQL, and working alongside AI tooling.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to AI-accelerated / human-in-the-loop configuration workflows.
  • The instinct to build reusable components instead of one-offs.

What success looks like (first 90 days)

  • Ramped on the platform's configuration model and authoring guides.
  • Independently configuring tariffs and special contracts that pass parallel-bill validation.
  • Contributing reusable components back to the shared library and helping tune the AI flywheel.

Location

  • US-based; open to remote, with periodic (2-3 days every 2-3 months) on-site travel to customer sites as the program requires.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity package.
  • The chance to help build a delivery function from the ground up and shape how AI transforms a vital industry, working with a rock-star team.
  • Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, remote-work flexibility, and 401(k) match.
  • A collaborative culture focused on innovation and impact.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY:

We are placing a Staff Capital Cost Estimator (Class 3 & 4) on behalf of a global leader in manufacturing. This is a company where people don't just come to work, they build careers. This role owns the estimating function for capital projects across a large-scale North American manufacturing and distribution network, covering facility expansions, warehouse improvements, and continuous improvement initiatives across the global supply chain.

This is a high-impact role. You'll be the first dedicated estimator in the organization, supporting capital expansion projects at manufacturing and distribution facilities across North America. You'll work hand-in-hand with engineering, operations, supply chain, and project management teams to translate project concepts and designs into clear financial insights.

If you're someone who gets energized by complex problems, likes having a seat at the table, and can translate technical scope into financial insight that leadership actually acts on, this is the role for you.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Developing Class 3 and Class 4 capital cost estimates for manufacturing, warehouse, and facility expansion projects
  • Producing detailed quantity take-offs and cost breakdowns across multiple engineering disciplines — equipment, civil/structural, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation
  • Building, refining, and owning estimating methodologies and tools for the organization
  • Reviewing engineering drawings, specs, scope of work documents, bid packages, and vendor/contractor quotes for accuracy and completeness
  • Collaborating directly with business stakeholders, the design team, and project engineers to scope and estimate capital projects

  • Proven experience with Class 3 and Class 4 estimation for Industrial and Manufacturing projects.
  • Experience estimating high-budget Industrial/Manufacturing projects valued $20million+
  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. — no sponsorship is available for this role

Education Bachelor's degree in Engineering (any discipline) or Construction Management

Required Technical Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with industry-standard estimating software — tools like ProEst, Procore, RS Means, or comparable platforms (specific tools are flexible; you must have used professional estimating software)

  • Experience developing Scope of Work documents and reviewing approval vendors and contract bid packages
  • Experience with project management including coordination of cross-functional teams

Strongly Preferred:

  • Background from a general contractor, engineering firm, or construction management firm focused on capital/industrial projects
  • Industrial or chemical estimating experience is preferred over commercial or retail construction

Nice to have, but not required: Strong candidates without these are still encouraged to apply.

  • Membership or certification through ASPE (American Society of Professional Estimators)

RDQ227R1175

While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.

About Databricks

Databricks is the data and AI company. More than 12,000 organizations worldwide — including Comcast, Condé Nast, Grammarly, and over 50% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to unify and democratize data, analytics and AI.

Databricks is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices around the globe and was founded by the original creators of Lakehouse, Apache Spark™, Delta Lake and MLflow.

About the Team

The Continuous Monitoring (ConMon) team at Databricks builds and operates the engineering infrastructure that keeps Databricks' security control posture visible, measurable, and defensible at all times.

We build automation that continuously assesses whether security controls are actually working across cloud environments, SaaS platforms, identity systems, and enterprise applications — surfacing drift, coverage gaps, and control failures as they happen rather than at the next audit.

Our work sits at the intersection of security engineering and GRC: we turn control requirements into code, evidence collection into automation, and security posture into intelligence that drives decisions.

The ConMon team also maintains security tooling and scanning infrastructure to aid control evaluation. This includes scanning for secret leaks, asset vulnerabilities, and SAST.

As Databricks' security program, cloud footprint, and regulatory obligations all scale, the Continuous Monitoring team is responsible for ensuring the company's control posture is always verifiable, always current, and never a surprise.

The Role

Databricks is looking for a Senior Manager to lead the Continuous Monitoring team.

You will own the engineering function that measures whether Databricks' security controls are working — across cloud infrastructure, identity, SaaS, and enterprise systems — and turns that measurement into something the Security organization, and its auditors, can rely on.

That includes demonstrating control posture against the frameworks the business carries (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, PCI DSS, and emerging AI governance requirements), but the underlying question is broader: are the controls Databricks depends on actually in place and operating everywhere they are supposed to be?

This is an engineering management role. The team writes production Python, operates data pipelines against cloud and SaaS APIs, and integrates with GRC and security tooling. Success is measured in control coverage, the accuracy and timeliness of what the team reports, and how quickly gaps get to the people who can close them.

The role requires enough technical depth to review that work credibly, and enough judgement to prioritize the controls where measurement actually reduces risk.

As the leader of Continuous Monitoring, you'll be responsible for growing and developing the team; setting a clear vision, priority, and strategy; making the case for the headcount and tooling the program needs; and building durable partnerships across GRC (SAC, SAF, Governance, Risk Management, TPRM), IT, Legal, and Engineering — the organizations that own the controls your team monitors.

The Impact You Will Have

Team Building & People Leadership

  • Hire strong Security Software Engineers who bring genuine engineering skill to compliance automation.
  • Support engineers in their career development with clear, specific feedback; develop senior ICs into technical leaders and grow the next generation of security engineering managers.
  • Set and hold a high bar for engineering quality: code review standards, reliability and observability expectations for automation pipelines, and documentation that remains useful across audit cycles and team changes.
  • Build a team that combines GRC domain knowledge with software engineering discipline, and hire for both.

Control Measurement Program Ownership

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Databricks' continuous monitoring platform — control state collection at cloud scale, continuous posture assessment, security and GRC tooling integration, and remediation tracking.
  • Define what the program measures and why: prioritize the controls whose failure would matter most to Databricks' security posture, rather than defaulting to the set a given framework happens to enumerate.
  • Ensure coverage keeps pace with the business — new cloud environments, new products and services, new certifications and regulatory obligations, and AI governance controls that current tooling does not yet assess.
  • Reduce manual evidence collection systematically; set and track targets for automated control coverage, freshness, and audit burden on Engineering teams.
  • Own the accuracy of the team's output, including false positive rates; findings should be reliable enough that control owners act on them without re-verification.

Posture Visibility & Executive Intelligence

  • Own the security posture dashboards, metrics, and reporting that give Security and GRC leadership an accurate, timely view of control health across the company.
  • Define the metrics the program reports on — control coverage, drift, time-to-remediate, and where the organization is exposed — and build the reporting that leadership uses to make security investment and prioritization decisions.
  • Present the team's findings to senior leadership: control gaps and drift, their risk implications, and the effort required to remediate them.
  • Make the same measurement data serve both audiences: evidence an auditor will accept, and signal the company can act on.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Execution

  • Establish productive working relationships with GRC (SAC, SAF, Governance, Risk Management, TPRM), Enterprise Security, Product Security, Security Operations, IT, Legal, and Engineering leadership — the teams who own the controls, the evidence, and the remediation.
  • Partner with Enterprise Security and Product Security so control measurement reflects how systems are actually built and configured, and feed coverage gaps back to the teams who own those controls.
  • Partner with SAC and SAF to ensure monitoring output meets auditor and 3PAO evidence standards, and with Governance to keep control monitoring aligned to policy as standards evolve.
  • Coordinate with Risk Management and Security Operations on metric definitions and reporting boundaries so the organization gets one coherent picture of control health rather than three overlapping ones.
  • Coordinate execution across teams to unblock cross-cutting initiatives: telemetry gaps in Engineering-owned systems, GRC platform migrations, and multi-quarter automation programs.
  • Make effective priority and resourcing decisions within the team; be accountable for defining and achieving the team's OKRs and KPIs.

Technology Decisions

  • Lead build-vs.-buy evaluations for CSPM, SSPM, GRC automation, and security posture tooling; assess platforms on integration capability, measurement fidelity, maintenance cost, and fit with existing pipelines, and make the recommendation to Security and GRC leadership.
  • Keep the program's operating costs defensible — cloud spend, tooling, and the engineering time monitoring consumes — and be able to explain the tradeoff between monitoring coverage and what it costs to run at scale.
  • Track what the program will need to measure next — changes in Databricks' architecture and threat exposure, new SOC 2 criteria, FedRAMP continuous monitoring changes, and AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act) — and translate them into roadmap decisions early enough to build for them.

What We Look For

  • 2+ years of prior management experience leading Engineering or Security engineering teams.
  • Typically 12+ years of experience, or an advanced degree plus 8 years, preferably focused on security engineering, security posture monitoring, or compliance automation.
  • Sufficient technical depth to review the work of the team: can read and critique Python automation, evaluate an integration architecture, and assess whether a monitoring approach will hold up in production.
  • Solid understanding of security controls and where they fail in practice — identity and access, configuration management, logging coverage, vulnerability management, and data protection — enough to judge whether a given measurement is telling you anything useful.
  • Solid cloud security knowledge across at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) — IAM, audit logging, CSPM concepts, and cloud-native security services.
  • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, or equivalent) at a level sufficient to assess whether a control monitoring design will satisfy an auditor.
  • Previous experience building security posture monitoring or compliance automation at scale, with attention to accuracy, coverage, and cost tradeoffs (experience with Databricks is preferred).
  • Focused on defining and driving efficiencies and improvements within the team; accountable for defining and achieving targets (e.g. OKRs, KPIs).
  • Makes effective priority decisions on resourcing and alignment within the team.
  • Strong communicator across technical, GRC, and executive audiences — can explain automation architecture to auditors and compliance requirements to engineers.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud security posture management (CSPM/SSPM) platforms at an architecture level.
  • Experience with FedRAMP continuous monitoring programs at a leadership level.
  • Hands-on background with GRC automation platforms (Vanta, Drata, ServiceNow GRC, Archer, or equivalent) at an implementation or architecture level.
  • Experience building automated monitoring for AI system controls and AI governance frameworks.
  • Track record of building or scaling a security measurement or compliance engineering function from early-stage to mature operations.
  • Background in security operations, detection engineering, or security architecture that informs which controls are worth measuring.
  • Experience with front-end development.
  • CISSP, CISM, CISA, or equivalent certifications.

raw.description:
Online werken als klinisch psycholoog in een team dat digitale zorg niet ziet als noodoplossing, maar als dé manier om het beter, slimmer en mensgerichter te doen.
Geen wachtkamers of vaste kantoortijden, maar ruimte voor flexibel werken vanuit huis en volledig digitaal, zonder in te leveren op persoonlijk contact of kwaliteit. Bij de Digitale Poli maak je deel uit van een enthousiast team dat werkt aan snelle, doelgerichte zorg met oog voor herstel, veerkracht en zingeving. Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van de GGZ.

Wat ga je doen?

Als klinisch psycholoog ben je regiebehandelaar binnen een multidisciplinair online team. Je voert zelfstandig psychotherapie en diagnostiek uit, met aandacht voor complexe problematiek. Je begeleidt basispsychologen en GZ-psychologen in opleiding, en draagt actief bij aan hun professionele groei.

Je werkt vanuit huis, maar staat er niet alleen voor: via dagelijks contact in overleggen en samenwerking binnen behandelingen blijf je verbonden met het team. Daarnaast lever je een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan de ontwikkeling van ons behandelaanbod en een inspirerende leeromgeving. Je taken bestaan onder andere uit: het voeren van intakes, opstellen en evalueren van behandelplannen, systeemgesprekken, deelnemen aan overleggen, uitvoeren van ROM-onderzoek en het ontwikkelen van (groeps)therapieën.

Wat hebben we jou te bieden?

Bij Altrecht heeft je werk betekenis: samen met bevlogen collega’s en een sterk netwerk van zorg- en kennispartners maak je écht verschil in de ggz. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te zijn, mee te denken en te groeien, als professional én als mens.

Je komt te werken in een organisatie vol mogelijkheden, met diverse (TopGGz) specialismen en meerdere werklocaties in en rondom Utrecht. We kijken naar jou als persoon, je ambities en je voorkeuren zoals behandelprogramma’s en woon-werkafstand. Samen vinden we de rol die het beste bij je past.

Daarnaast krijg je van ons:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 6.798,- tot € 9.442,- (FWG 75 in de cao GGZ) op basis van 36 uur per week.

  • Een volledige dertiende maand (8,33% eindejaarsuitkering) en 8,33% vakantiegeld.

  • 166 vakantie-uren en 35 levensfase-uren per jaar (o.b.v. 36 uur per week). Extra tijd voor jezelf? Je kunt tot 36 uur extra verlof bijkopen.

  • Een jaarlijks balansbudget. Je kunt het bedrag uit laten betalen, extra verlof kopen of het bedrag verhogen tot € 1.400,- als je het inzet voor een vrijetijdscursus.

  • Pensioenopbouw bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn, collectieve inkomensverzekering en korting op aanvullende zorgverzekering (IZZ of Zilveren Kruis).

  • Alflex, ons meerkeuzesysteem voor extra arbeidsvoorwaarden. Kies bijv. voor een fiets, sportschoolabonnement of reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Ruimte en mogelijkheden voor (door)groei! Je kunt scholingen volgen bij de Altrecht Academie, deelnemen aan organisatiebrede kennis & expertisenetwerken, meewerken aan onderzoek of jezelf verder ontwikkelen in de praktijk, via opleidingen en intervisie.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een klinisch psycholoog met een nieuwsgierige en innovatieve houding. Je ziet kansen in digitale zorg en durft te pionieren in een dynamisch en veranderend veld. Tegelijkertijd werk je zorgvuldig en zelfstandig, met een scherp oog voor complexe problematiek en het vermogen om regie te houden over behandelingen. Je gelooft in herstelgerichte zorg, werkt vanuit het gedachtegoed van positieve gezondheid en zet digitale middelen doelgericht in om écht van betekenis te zijn voor de cliënt.

Daarnaast ben je een echte teamspeler die collega’s weet te begeleiden en graag bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van ons behandelaanbod. Je hebt ervaring met individuele en groepsbehandelingen, blijft rustig in hectiek en schakelt snel wanneer dat nodig is. Je staat stevig in je schoenen, bent BIG-geregistreerd als klinisch psycholoog – of je bent bijna klaar met je opleiding – en je herkent jezelf in onze kernwaarden: passend, vertrouwen, verbindend en (veer)krachtig.

Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden: passend, vertrouwen, verbindend en (veer-)krachtig.

Wie zijn wij?

De Digitale Poli is een innovatieve behandelomgeving waar we volledig online zorg bieden aan mensen met angst-, trauma-, stemmings- en persoonlijkheidsproblematiek. Met beeldbellen, chat en interactieve modules bieden we intensieve behandelingen die flexibel én persoonlijk zijn, en altijd afgestemd op de behoefte van de cliënt.

Onze aanpak is gebaseerd op het gedachtegoed van positieve gezondheid: we kijken breder dan klachten en diagnoses en richten ons op veerkracht, zingeving en dagelijks functioneren. Vanuit een transdiagnostische visie werken we evidence-based én mensgericht, in nauwe samenwerking met verschillende afdelingen binnen Altrecht. Zo bieden we snelle, toegankelijke en effectieve zorg, waarbij de eigen regie van de cliënt centraal staat. Als professional krijg je hier de kans om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe digitale behandeltechnieken, onderzoek te doen en zo bij te dragen aan toegankelijke, toekomstbestendige en effectieve ggz – mét behoud van menselijk contact, ook online.

Enthousiast en nu?

Solliciteer eenvoudig via de onderstaande button! Wil je eerst meer weten? Stuur gerust een berichtje of bel met Senada Nikocevic, teammanager, via 06-83110133.

Je bent ook van harte welkom voor een oriënterend gesprek, zodat je de sfeer bij ons kunt ervaren. We kijken ernaar uit om van je te horen!

Goed om te weten

  • Een dagdeel meelopen kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure. Zo leren wij elkaar beter kennen.

  • Acquisitie op basis van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

raw.description:
About Perceptive

Our mission is to shape the future of clinical research. With decades of experience and the brightest minds in the industry, we help the global biopharmaceutical industry bring new, advanced medical treatments to market, faster.

We seek to change the world, and with the support of our teams across the globe, we flourish together. At Perceptive, we are one team. We learn, grow and win together.

Are you ready to help change the world?

Apart from job satisfaction, we can offer you:

HEALTH:
- Medical, Dental and Vision benefits for you and your family, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)

YOURSELF:
- Paid time off policy including holidays and sick time
- Internal growth and development programs & trainings

WEALTH:
401(k) program, life & accident insurance and disability insurance

About the role

As Director, Image Analysis & Radiopharmaceutical Therapy, you will provide integrated scientific and management leadership across imaging-driven clinical trials, providing scientific guidance on development of modelling, analysis design, results interpretation and dosimetry techniques to clinical trials. You are accountable for both the scientific integrity and end-to-end delivery of image analysis data supporting multi-center trials, including Radiopharmaceutical Therapy (RPT) and advanced imaging modalities such as PET/SPECT and MRI. This role combines scientific leadership and oversight with functional and people management responsibility to ensure consistent, high-quality data delivery, robust methodology, and operational excellence aligned with business objectives and regulatory expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership Responsibilities

  • Act as the functional scientific authority for imaging and quantitative analysis methodologies, particularly in Radiopharmaceutical Therapy.
  • Act as the senior external scientific interface for sponsors and key stakeholders, providing critical scientific input and guidance for interactions with sponsors regarding analysis design and results interpretation.
  • Provide scientific leadership and authoritative scientific judgement on complex, high-risk clinical trials utilizing medical imaging and clinical data.
  • Author, review, and approve scientific documentation including imaging guidelines, charters, and results summaries.
  • Oversee the development and oversight of quantitative image analysis and dosimetry workflows.
  • Ensure scientific rigor, regulatory readiness, and methodological consistency across Image Analysis studies.

Image Analysis Delivery & Operational Excellence

  • Hold ultimate accountability for holistic image analysis data delivery across relevant programs and portfolios.
  • Define and enforce standards, SOPs, quality frameworks, and delivery models for Image Analysis within the organisation.
  • Set delivery performance expectations and monitor outcomes through leading senior‑level functional governance forums.
  • Resolve escalated scientific, quality, or delivery risks.
  • Partner cross‑functionally to ensure scalable, compliant delivery models align to agreed business priorities.
  • ​Provide coaching and support to team for client interactions, including capabilities presentations, scientific & medical services support, and data presentation/interpretation.
  • Ensure timely, consistent, and high-quality data outputs.

People & Functional Leadership

  • Lead and shape a high-performing global Image Analysis function, providing direction to Mangers, Scientist and Analyst teams, establishing clear accountability.
  • Provide line management, coaching, and performance management for team members.
  • Build and sustain a high-performing, engaged and diverse Image Analysis and Scientific organization with skills aligned to the business strategy and growth.
  • Allocate resources effectively across a dynamic portfolio.
  • ​​Develop future scientific and operational leaders.
  • Coach managers on performance management, feedback, and talent development.
  • ​Ensure succession planning and skills readiness for critical roles.
  • Provide insight and develop business cases to support financial planning and decision‑making for investment priorities, capacity planning, and resourcing discussions.

Stakeholder Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary scientific and delivery point of contact for external stakeholders for Image Analysis and RPT capabilities.
  • Translate scientific and operational requirements into executable strategies.
  • Lead scientific consultation, delivery assurance discussions, issue resolution, and interpretation of results.
  • Translate scientific and operational requirements into executable approaches.
  • Facilitates business decision-making processes.  
  • Represent Image Analysis and RPT capabilities in internal governance, prioritization, planning and strategic forums.

Other

  • Carries out any other reasonably duties as requested.

Functional Competencies (Technical knowledge/Skills)

  • ​Demonstrable knowledge of nuclear medicine imaging.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of relevant scientific terminology and practices.
  • Proven understanding of research methodologies and pragmatic application in a regulated environment.
  • Technical proficiency in image analysis and associated software platforms.
  • Proven ability in other software packages (Microsoft Office, Matlab, etc).
  • Understanding of basic data analytics, meaningful trends, and implications on the quality control of results.
  • Wholistic understanding of data delivery processes.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Must have the ability to work methodically in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment.
  • Demonstratable ability to apply critical thinking to problems and tasks.
  • Ability to identify and implement process improvements, including management of stakeholders.
  • Proactively grows skill through trainings and guides their team to do the same.
  • Excellent mentor who can foster professional development and growth of their team.
  • Ability to manage a globally distributed and multi disciplined team, including motivating, developing and coordinating team members.
  • Organized leader and mentor with the ability to identify the appropriate leadership style to manage the individuals in their team.
  • Financial management and acumen, with an ability to strictly manage a complex and large budget to a demanding target.
  • ​Maintains an up-to-date awareness of trends, tools, technology, techniques and processes that affect image analysis technology within the Life sciences domain and how it affects customers adopting our products.

Experience, Education, and Certifications

  • Significant demonstrable experience in both academic and/or industrial instrumentation/ image processing environments.
  • ​Demonstrable experience in image analysis; key focus on modelling and dosimetry techniques.
  • Proven line management and leadership ability in the same or similar role.
  • ​Solid proven experience of working in and knowledge of medical imaging or clinical development in the life sciences industry.
  • ​Experience using both knowledge and tools to communicate progress to Stakeholders and credibly represent the business.
  • ​Bachelor's Degree (Medical degree/ PhD) in a quantitative field, ideally
  • in nuclear medicine, physics, biophysics or biomedical engineering, or equivalent project-related experience.
  • ​English: Fluent.

This role is remote. Candidates located in AZ, CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, MA, MO, NH, NJ, NC, PA, UT, VA are preferred. The annual base salary range for this role is $148,067- $211,523. This range represents the anticipated initial annual salary and will vary depending on several factors including the candidate’s experience and skills as well as market rate adjustment.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for mobile developers to build BJAK's AI Neobank App across Android and iOS.

This role is for strong mobile builders who can ship clean, reliable and intuitive mobile experiences, whether their main strength is Android, iOS or both.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship mobile features for Android and/or iOS.

  • Create simple mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product, design and backend teams to turn complex journeys into usable mobile products.

  • Integrate APIs and handle edge cases, loading states, errors and production issues.

  • Improve app performance, reliability, crash rate and user experience.

  • Support fast product launches, experiments and iterations across mobile journeys.

  • Help set high standards for mobile product quality across the app.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.

  • Strong experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • Experience shipping production apps used by real users.

  • Strong product sense and attention to mobile UX.

  • Able to work with APIs, analytics, crash logs and production feedback.

  • Fast, practical and comfortable owning work with limited handholding.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks like a product builder, not just a mobile coder.

  • Cares about smooth flows, small details and real user behaviour.

  • Can work across ambiguity and ship without waiting for perfect specs.

  • Takes production quality personally.

  • Honest about what they built directly versus what the wider team delivered.

This Role Is Not For

  • Developers who only want to build isolated screens.

  • People who do not care about UX, performance or reliability.

  • Candidates who cannot explain their own contribution clearly.

  • People who need heavy guidance for every task.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a high-growth environment.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Poland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Poland.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Are you a Referral?

Encova is only able to employ associates who reside and work within specific U.S. states. Our current policies are based on the laws in states in which we are registered for payroll. Our current footprint includes:
