JOB OBJECTIVE:

The Lost Time Claims Specialist, Workers’ Compensation primarily manages indemnity claims. The Lost Time Claims Specialist is responsible for the investigation, evaluation, and determination of compensability for work-related injury and disease claims following established guidelines to determine benefit eligibility. The Lost Time Claims Specialist also serves as a resource to Medical Only Claims Specialists and Claims Specialist Trainees. The position’s objective is to provide superior service in a cost-effective manner to achieve best possible outcomes as well as proactively collaborate across the enterprise to ensure alignment of objectives and foster continuous improvement.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
1. Evaluates and establishes an action plan to manage medical and indemnity benefits associated with injury and occupational disease claims to their most cost- effective conclusion.
2. Decides the outcome of the claim using sound judgment by applying established policy, procedures, regulations and guidelines.
3. Gathers facts by conducting interviews with all involved parties and considers all the elements of the claim prior to issuing a decision.
4. Take recorded statements when necessary.
5. Determines eligibility of indemnity and medical benefits once salary information and medical treatment plans have been secured and processed within the designated authority levels.
6. Utilize proactive reserving behaviors to ensure adequate case reserves which reflect the probable ultimate outcome based on the current known circumstances throughout the life of the claim.
7. Actively identifies and develops the investigation of and pursuit of subrogation recoveries when possible.
8. Consults with assigned claim director, return to work specialists, nurse case managers, internal/external medical, and legal on current and/or recommended treatment, litigation or rehabilitation plans to ensure claims outcomes are achievable and appropriate.
9. Works collaboratively with the injured worker, employer, outside counsel, and health and rehabilitation professionals to manage the claims costs and promote quality medical care.
10. Works collaboratively with the injured worker, employer, assigned return to work specialist, and medical providers to facilitate the injured worker’s safe and timely return to work.
11. Manages claims litigation, including expenses, by collaborating and providing direction to panel counsel throughout the life of the claim.
12. Analyzes reports from external resources such as physicians, attorneys, and/or vocational rehabilitation experts to evaluate and adjust claim strategies as needed.
13. Evaluates and negotiates claim settlements utilizing human relation skills and technical knowledge to achieve the best possible outcome.
14. Presents and summarizes claim details at internal team staffing, participates in discussions, and provides guidance as needed.
15. Consults with assigned claim director if the loss becomes significantly complex or presents significantly increasing financial exposure.
16. Follows established claims best practices related to medical management, litigation, fraud/abuse and recovery.
17. Effectively and independently uses available resources to prioritize, organize, and complete work in a timely manner to meet jurisdictional requirements, timeframes, and internal metrics.
18. Develops presentations for special projects such as internal/external meetings and conferences as needed.
19. Along with the claim director, regional vice president and other claims staff, participates in claim reviews, onboardings, etc. for our policyholders and agents.
20. Proactively collaborate with our policyholders to ensure alignment of objectives and foster continuous improvement.

OTHER FUNCTIONS:
1. Nonessential function: other duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
• Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university is preferred.
• Three years of experience in the field of workers’ compensation insurance required.
• Ability to manage claims through the litigation process.
• Internal candidates must demonstrate knowledge of Encova Best Practices guidelines and meet quality standards.
• One valid workers’ compensation adjuster license is strongly preferred. Must be eligible to obtain additional licenses as required.
• Must pass the claims adjuster license exam(s) as assigned within 90 days of being hired.
• Preference may be shown to candidates with multiple state claims management experience.
• Experience in workers’ compensation claims practices and laws, court procedures, precedents and state statutes.
• Ability to use logic and sound reasoning to identify alternative solutions for problem-solving.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong analytical skills.

• Ability to multitasks and manage time effectively and productively.
• Work effectively independently as well as in a team environment.
• Develop and maintain strong, effective internal and external relationships.
• Work effectively in a paperless environment.
• Skilled in the use of laptops, claims management systems, and other typical business-related programs such as Microsoft Office suite.

With success in mind, we make an ongoing effort to provide an environment that offers challenging, stimulating, and financially rewarding opportunities. Join us to discover a work experience where you can learn and grow to your fullest potential.

raw.description:
O QUE ESTAMOS BUSCANDO? 🎯

Somos a primeira e maior plataforma all-in-one no mercado de gestão de despesas e viagens corporativas. Nossos clientes e soluções não param de crescer, então também temos ampliado nosso time de Sucesso do Cliente! Queremos pessoas que tenham vivência no relacionamento com clientes, com muita vontade de aprender e que consigam propor soluções criativas para retenção de clientes! 🚀

NO QUE VOCÊ VAI TRABALHAR? 🤩

Como priorizamos proporcionar a melhor experiência possível para nossos clientes, precisamos oferecer cuidados especiais a esses negócios. Queremos, junto a você, continuar entregando experiências fantásticas a essas organizações! 💻📈💙


Na vaga de ANALISTA DE RETENÇÃO, você será responsável por:

  • Monitorar indicadores de engajamento, uso do produto e riscos na carteira de clientes do segmento Business;
  • Realizar contatos proativos e planos de ação para engajar contas em risco antes da abertura do chamado de cancelamento
  • Atender e negociar solicitações formais de cancelamento de clientes do segmento;
  • Identificar os reais motivos de insatisfação/saída e aplicar estratégias de reversão e negociação comercial/operacional;
  • Manter os sistemas e relatórios de controle de chamados e motivos de churn devidamente atualizados;
  • Mapear oportunidades de melhoria no produto e nos processos internos a partir dos feedbacks dos clientes;
  • Colaborar com os pares do segmento e interagir com o time de CSM;

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ? 💡

  • Perfil Comunicativo e Empático: Facilidade de articulação verbal e escrita para conduzir conversas difíceis e negociações com clientes em momento de insatisfação;
  • Resiliência e Contorno de Objeções: Capacidade de manter a calma sob pressão, ter escuta ativa e propor soluções criativas de retenção;
  • Orientação para Dados e Organização: Disciplina para registrar interações, acompanhar métricas de saúde da carteira e organizar o volume diário de contatos;
  • Proatividade e Atitude Dono: Vontade de aprender rápido e propor melhorias no fluxo preventivo.

QUAIS SÃO OS REQUISITOS? ✔️

  • Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar 40 horas semanais.
  • Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Atendimento ao Cliente, Retenção, Vendas ou Suporte.

E O ALGO A MAIS?💡

  • Conhecimento básico de metodologias de CS (Health Score, NBR, Churn, engajamento);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM como pipedrive;
  • Experiência em startups e/ou SaaS (B2B);
  • Já ter trabalhado com IA em experiências anteriores é diferencial.

Informações adicionais

O QUE VAMOS TE OFERECER? 🎉


  • Home-office durante toda a sua jornada, com um time completamente disposto a caminhar ao seu lado (mesmo que a alguns quilômetros de distância);
  • Convênio médico sem coparticipação e com cobertura nacional;
  • Liberdade para alocar seus benefícios em vale-alimentação e/ou vale-refeição, quando quiser e como você preferir;
  • Acesso a medicamentos e produtos de saúde com preços reduzidos;
  • Todas as ferramentas de trabalho (notebook, fone, mouse etc.);
  • Bônus por indicações contratadas em processos seletivos;
  • Acesso ao WellHub e TotalPass, com várias soluções de bem-estar;
  • Contato próximo com fundadores, sócios e sócias;
  • Muita liberdade (e apoio) para ser quem você é;
  • Ambientedescontraído e colaborativo;
  • Dress-code livreno dia a dia;
  • Acesso aplano odontológico;
  • Licença-maternidade e paternidade estendidas;
  • Dayoff de aniversário;
  • Muito aprendizado e crescimento!

Senior EPC Projektmanager (Turnkey Infrastruktur) (m/w/d)

Biogas-, Biomethan- und Biomasseheizkraftwerksprojekte
Standort: Deutschland (Remote) (Nort, West region)

Jobbeschreibung

Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der erneuerbaren Energien.

Für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung unserer Biogas-, Biomethan- und Biomasseprojekte suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior EPC Projektmanager (Turnkey Infrastruktur).

In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für Planung, Ausschreibung, Vergabe, Vertragsmanagement sowie die Umsetzung der Infrastruktur- und Bauleistungen innerhalb unserer Energieprojekte.

Dies umfasst nicht nur die klassischen Infrastrukturgewerke wie Gebäude, Straßen und Medienanschlüsse, sondern auch die übergeordnete Verantwortung für Bauablaufplanung, Terminsteuerung, Baukostenbudgets sowie die Ausführungskoordination.

Sie fungieren als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen internen Teams und allen externen Projektbeteiligten Firmen und Partnern und steuern sämtliche infrastrukturellen Projektbestandteile bis zur erfolgreichen Fertigstellung.

Warum wir?

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung der Energiewende und Dekarbonisierung der Energieversorgung;

  • Mitarbeit an innovativen Projekten im Bereich Biogas, Biomethan und Biomasse;

  • Dynamisches und wachsendes Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen;

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und großer Gestaltungsspielraum;

  • Projekte mit hoher Relevanz für eine nachhaltige Energieversorgung;

  • Junges, ambitioniertes Team;

  • Entwicklungsperspektiven bis hin zu Führungspositionen.

Aufgabenbereiche

Projektverantwortung (Turnkey EPC)

  • Gesamtverantwortung für den Infrastruktur- und Bauanteil innerhalb von EPC-Projekten;

  • Verantwortung für die Bauablauf- und Terminplanung (Scheduling, Sequenzierung, Koordination);

  • Verantwortung für das Baukostenbudget sowie laufende Kostenkontrolle;

  • Koordination aller Projektbeteiligten Firmen und Partner (z. B. Bauunternehmen, Planungsbüros, Lieferanten und Installationsfirmen).

Technischer Einkauf und Ausschreibungsmanagement

  • Erstellung von Leistungsbeschreibungen und Ausschreibungsunterlagen;

  • Einholung und Koordination von Angeboten für Infrastrukturleistungen wie:

    • Hallen und Betriebsgebäude;

    • Büro- und Sozialgebäude;

    • Straßen- und Flächenbau;

    • Erd- und Tiefbauarbeiten;

    • Elektrische Infrastruktur (Netzanschluss, Trafostationen, Verkabelung);

    • Wasser- und Abwasseranschlüsse;

    • Gasanschlüsse und Netzinfrastruktur;

      • Aufbau und Pflege eines Netzwerks aus Bauunternehmen, Lieferanten und Partnern;
      • Organisation und Durchführung von Bietergesprächen.

Angebotsbewertung und Vergabe

Entwicklung standardisierter Bewertungsmethoden für Angebote, und Wirtschaftlicher und technischer Vergleich hinsichtlich:

  • Preis;

  • Qualität;

  • Termine;

  • Risiken: erstellung von Vergabeempfehlungen und mitwirkung bei Vertragsverhandlungen und Vergabeentscheidungen.

Requirements

Qualifikationen

Abgeschlossenes Studium in:

  • Bauingenieurwesen;

  • Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen;

  • oder vergleichbar.

Alternativ:

  • Bautechniker / Meister mit entsprechender Erfahrung.

Erfahrung

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in:

  • Bau- oder Infrastrukturprojekten;

  • Ausschreibung und Vergabe von Bauleistungen;

  • Vertragsmanagement (EPC / Bauverträge);

  • Bauüberwachung und Projektumsetzung;

    • Erfahrung mit Industrieanlagen oder Energieprojekten von Vorteil;
    • Kenntnisse im Bauvertragsrecht (idealerweise VOB).

Sprachkenntnisse

  • Deutsch (C1);

  • Englisch (mindestens B2).

Persönliche Fähigkeiten

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke;

  • Strukturierte und wirtschaftliche Denkweise;

  • Starkes Verhandlungsgeschick;

  • Technisches Verständnis für Bau- und Infrastrukturprojekte;

  • Hohe Organisationsfähigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein;

  • Hands-on-Mentalität und Durchsetzungsstärke.

Was wir bieten

  • Mitarbeit in einem Unternehmen, das innovative Projekte im Bereich erneuerbare Energien entwickelt und aktiv zur Energiewende beiträgt;

  • Attraktive Vergütung entsprechend Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung;

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag;

  • 24 Urlaubstage pro Jahr mit der Möglichkeit, auf bis zu 40 Tage zu erhöhen;

  • Firmenlaptop und -telefon (auch zur privaten Nutzung);

  • 20 € netto monatlich für Heimarbeit;

  • Zuschuss zur Einrichtung des Homeoffice-Arbeitsplatzes;

  • Fahrtkostenzuschuss;

  • Umfangreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten;

  • Perspektivisch Entwicklung in eine Führungsrolle.

Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Bitte senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen inklusive Lebenslauf, frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin und Gehaltsvorstellung über unser Bewerbungsportal
Möchten Sie vorab weitere Informationen? Dann wenden Sie sich bitte an Irene Tan-Perk (Personalvermittlerin) unter 088 – 460 90 80.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Job Title:Senior DevOps Engineer / Ruby
Reporting into:VP of Engineering
Location:Remote (North America, South America, and Europe)
As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will help run the cloud infrastructure that powers our Ruby API for our family of LGBTQ+ mobile dating apps. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about architecture and monads! Ok just kidding about the last part -- but you can see more about our approach to API development in our Medium blog series here. The position is 40 hours per week and ongoing/full-time.

What you'll do:

  • Maintain a complex backend which processes more than 350 million web server requests per day
  • Manage, modernize and innovate across our fleet of API, process and database servers running in the AWS cloud
  • Terraform our architecture to ensure cloud architectural consistency
  • Build a modern API application atop a functional architecture in Ruby, Ruby on Rails, and/or Sinatra
  • Build well factored, maintainable, and tested code using RSpec with Test & Behavior Driven Development (TDD & BDD)
  • Understand and build using strong architectural patterns beyond the standard MVC of Rails
  • Have a strong sense of OO programming and Architectural patterns
  • Be able to work with, mentor, and guide a distributed team of developers
  • Team members will be expected to align to the working and pairing hours of their team in their respective regions. Our team writes code in pairs, and engineering teams screen-share with each other a minimum of 4 hours per day.
  • We are pioneers of architectural linters, and are working on a new open-source architectural linter for Ruby inspired by our experience in Kotlin. This enables us to apply architectural principles across a global, distributed team
You can see more about our architectural approach on our Engineering blog here. As a DevOps engineer you should definitely read our guest post in the AWS Engineering blog here.

Requirements

Timezone requirements:
  • Because we are a global, remote, distributed company, timezone alignment is critical
  • If you are EU-based, you must be available to work between 11am CET and 8pm CET (Winter) or 12pm CET and 9pm CET (Summer)
  • If you are Brasil-based, you must be available to work between 8am EST and 5pm EST
  • If you are North America-based, you must be available to work between 8am EST and 5pm EST
Candidates must:
  • Be available to collaborate between 9a EST and 1p EST, regardless of your present timezone.
  • Have experience working for remote, global teams
  • Be excited about and open to pair programming
  • Be open to learning languages outside their current server specialty, such as Swift, Kotlin, Python or JavaScript
  • Senior-level expertise working with: Docker, K8s, SQL, Linux, and AWS
  • Fully understand and be able to critically review and evaluate all of the AI-generated code we produce
Who you are:
  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in computer science, related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • 5+ years of demonstrable devops (AWS or equivalent) experience
  • 5+ years of software development experience using any major application development language (Java/Ruby/Python/Go/.NET)
  • Experience using design and architecture patterns
  • Strong sense of ownership, ability to work independently, and proven track record of driving products
  • Shipped consumer API used concurrently by thousands of users.

Bonus if you have experience with:

  • Full stack knowledge of technologies like Ruby, Java, Python
  • Experience working with big data technologies and ETLs like Spark, S3, and Redshift
  • Experience with analytics platforms, CRM, and engagement platforms (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude, Moengage, Quicksight)
  • Experience completing product iterations based on insights from data
  • Knowledge of Python, Scala, Spark, Athena, or Databricks
And one more thing...
We spend a lot of time describing our technology and our approach on our Engineering Blog. If you want to impress us, take the time to read our blog posts, and let us know how what we've done compares to, or could have helped with, your experience. Given the volume of applications we read, the most impactful applications contain cover letters with specific examples, demonstrate understanding of the business in which we operate, and include updated and detailed LinkedIn profiles. Candidates using AI to apply for this role should consider how their cover letter contains specific examples of experience with our actual job requirements, as well as demonstrable interest in and understanding of our company and community.

Benefits

A 100% remote, 100% global team
Every day, the PSS product team comes together virtually from more than 18 cities in more than 12 countries. As a colleague at PSS, you can work from any timezone in North America, South America, or Europe. Benefits include:
  • 11 Paid Holidays
  • One paid week off at mid-year (PSS Summer Refresh Week)
  • Home Office Stipend - purchase furniture for your home setup
  • Paid Parental Leave
United States-based employees additionally receive the following benefits:
  • 401k plan with 6% match
  • Comprehensive, nation-wide healthcare coverage
  • Flexible Time Off
Perry Street is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, national origin, ancestry, medical condition, disability, marital status, caregiver status, pregnancy, citizenship, age, military or veteran status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Why Crump?

We understand that our teammates are more alike than we are different and that we are One Crump. Supported by leading technology tools and a collaborative work model, we empower our people to serve clients and support each other. Strong brands are built through consistent delivery of a company’s value proposition – for both its employees and its customers.

At Crump, we believe in investing in the teammates who work for us, supporting the business goals of the myriad professionals who work with us so they can best meet their clients’ needs, and bettering the communities that house our teammates. These beliefs have allowed Crump to maintain our standing as an industry top performer, not only as measured by sales results but, more importantly, by consistent customer and employee satisfaction and retention.

Job Summary

Provide life insurance producers with specific advanced planning and illustration support to generate life insurance sales. This includes, but is not limited to, understanding advanced estate and business planning concepts, case design, developing advanced planning marketing tools, and presenting planning concepts.

Job Description

Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

  • Advanced sales case design
  • Advanced case research and development
  • Ability to fully understand client life needs – income protection, estate planning, replacement
  • Review available approved products per wirehouse and select carriers, products, and design that are best for the client
  • Creation of advanced sales marketing tools
  • Preparation of sales presentation, including obtaining compliance approval from financial institution
  • Act as a liaison between financial institutions, agents and carrier home offices to facilitate sales
  • Support the sale of carrier specific and Crump proprietary advanced sales deliverables
  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of approved carriers & products by financial institution, including new products, product changes, transitions, repricing, limitations, riders, etc.
  • Effectively communicate on a regular basis with sales team, carrier wholesalers, internal sales desks, and case managers, to ensure open communication on product, changes, etc.

Required Qualifications:

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Effective interpersonal and written communication skills
  • Ability to provide excellent customer service to both internal and external customers
  • Effective time management skills
  • Ability to prioritize and accomplish multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Capable of working independently as well as in a team environment
  • Ability to work in a self-directed fashion
  • Experience with PCs in a Windows environment
  • Demonstrated proficiency in basic computer applications such as Microsoft Office software products
  • Ability to analyze problems and develop solutions
  • Ability to communicate with individuals at all levels of the organization
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent education, training and work-related experience
  • Experience with advanced case design, research and complex cases
  • Experience creating marketing tools to drive sales
  • Solid understanding of various tax and legal rules, as it pertains to life insurance
  • Excellent writing and technical research skills
  • Exceptional organizational skills
  • Knowledge of carrier life products, specific advanced sales concepts and illustration software

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional designation (CLU, CFP, ChFC, CPA, or related practices including law)
  • Insurance brokerage experience

A comprehensive benefits package that includes PTO, medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, disability insurance, and life insurance.

raw.excerpt: Le contexteVous rejoignez notre practice Infra Cloud & Cyber, un collectif de spécialistes qui réunit dans une même équipe les expertises d'infrastructure, de cloud, de DevOps/SRE et de cybersécurité.
raw.description:
Le contexte

Vous rejoignez notre practice Infra Cloud & Cyber, un collectif de spécialistes qui réunit dans une même équipe les expertises d'infrastructure, de cloud, de DevOps/SRE et de cybersécurité. Cette convergence est notre marque de fabrique : nous ne sécurisons pas le cloud après coup, nous concevons des infrastructures nativement sécurisées.

Au sein de la verticale Cloud, vous intervenez comme architecte référent GCP auprès de nos clients grands comptes, sur des projets de migration, de conception de plateformes et de modernisation d'infrastructures.

Une practice en construction, et vous en êtes acteur. Notre practice est engagée dans une démarche de structuration : construction d'offres packagées, développement d'accélérateurs, montée en puissance de nos partenariats. Vous ne rejoignez pas une organisation figée — vous aurez la possibilité réelle de faire évoluer la practice, de contribuer à la définition de nos offres et de laisser votre empreinte sur nos référentiels techniques.

Vos missions

Conception et architecture

  • Conception et architecture Concevoir des architectures GCP robustes, sécurisées et optimisées : landing zones, organisation des projets et des folders, IAM, VPC Service Controls, interconnexions hybrides
  • Définir les patterns d'architecture réutilisables et les standards techniques de la practice sur GCP
  • Arbitrer les choix technologiques en tenant compte des contraintes de coût, de sécurité, de conformité et d'exploitabilité

Delivery et accompagnement client

  • Piloter techniquement les phases de cadrage, de build et de mise en production
  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre les stratégies de migration : assessment, wave planning, exécution
  • Accompagner les équipes clientes dans leur montée en compétences et dans l'adoption des bonnes pratiques

Avant-vente et réponse aux appels d'offres

  • Participer à la rédaction technique de nos réponses aux appels d'offres : conception de la solution, argumentaire technique, chiffrage, plan de charge
  • Défendre nos propositions en soutenance client
  • Contribuer à la qualification technique des besoins clients et à la construction des trajectoires proposées

Contribution à la structuration de la practice

  • Construire et faire évoluer nos offres packagées sur le domaine cloud : définition du contenu, des livrables types, du modèle de chiffrage
  • Développer nos accélérateurs : modules Terraform durcis, landing zone de référence, framework FinOps, kits de migration
  • Contribuer à la structuration de la verticale Cloud : référentiels techniques, standards, capitalisation des retours d'expérience
  • Animer la communauté technique : partages en weekly de verticale, interventions en monthly de practice
  • Participer aux entretiens techniques de recrutement et à la qualification des profils

Le profil que nous recherchons

Diplôme et expérience

  • BAC +5 diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent
  • Expérience de 6 ans minimum, dont 3 ans sur Google Cloud Platform

Compétences techniques

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android software engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Portugal. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Portugal.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
The Department of Neurology is seeking a Biostatisticianfor the BIOS Division in the School of Medicine. The Biostatistician will analyze large scale, longitudinal data. Analyzed data is abstracted and extracted from electronic health records, laboratory and pharmacy databases, and patient reported outcomes surveys.

The Biostatistician will provide expertise on statistical design, data management (including data quality control), and data analyses to answer research questions using observational and longitudinal data. The Biostatistician will participate as a coauthor on manuscripts and presentations reporting study results.

Specific Duties and Responsibilities

  • Use and expand existing SAS and R programs to clean and organize incoming JHHCC and CNICS data.
  • Identify potential problems with study data and collaborate with data managers to resolve issues.
  • Read concept sheets and draft statistical analysis plans specific to research objectives.
  • Generate analytic data sets, codebooks, and other documentation.
  • Analyze individual-level data to answer scientific questions of interest.
  • Prepare data tables and figures for publication and presentation at scientific meetings.
  • Contribute to technical/scientific writing and review drafts of concept sheets, reports, posters, and manuscripts, particularly descriptions of statistical methods and interpretation of results.
  • Document decision making during conduct of studies and archive code for purposes of reproducibility of research findings.
  • Navigate shared files and contribute to shared files to create a transparent research workspace.
  • Assist with writing approach section of research proposals.
  • Attend meetings and provide status updates on data processing and research projects.
  • Use professional judgment in handling sensitive information.
  • Other duties as assigned.

In addition to the duties above

  • Support development of statistical analysis plans and data collections tools (e.g. CRFs).
  • Develop specifications for derived datasets used to generate data summaries and statistical analysis.
  • Program derived datasets to generate data summaries and statistical analysis.
  • Develop table, listings, and figures (TLFs) shells in preparation for analysis programming.
  • Program TLFs to support safety reviews (including DSMBs), publications, and ongoing study reporting.
  • Program additional ad hoc requests to support clinical trial conduct and reporting including: sample size calculations and data missingness.
  • Collaborate with project management to develop timelines for analysis.


Minimum Qualifications
  • Master's Degree in Biostatistics, Epidemiology, or related quantitative field.
  • Additional education may substitute for required experience, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.


Preferred Qualifications

Technical Skills & Expected Level of Proficiency

  • Biostatistical Analysis - Developing
  • Data Management and Analysis - Developing
  • Data Validation and Quality Assurance - Developing
  • Data Visualization - Developing
  • Regulatory Compliance - Developing
  • Reproducible Research Practices - Developing
  • Scientific Communication - Developing
  • Statistical Methods - Developing
  • Statistical Programming - Developing

The core technical skills listed are most essential; additional technical skills may be required based on specific division or department needs.

raw.description:
Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Native) – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en RTL met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNNI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities binnen onze smart devices practice te realiseren zoeken we een Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Native). Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwerpen van zwaarbelaste backend-omgevingen, het bewaken van technische standaarden en het meedenken over digitale oplossingen die écht verschil maken binnen mobiele applicaties voor miljoenen gebruikers.

Jouw rol

Als Senior Software Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de cloud-architectuur en de backend-trajecten van onze smart device applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat backends standaard zijn geoptimaliseerd voor mobiele apps.

Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en je krijgt er energie van om complexe business-requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en denkt proactief mee over databeveiliging, cloud-kosten en schaalbaarheid. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwerpen en programmeren van complexe cloud-native architecturen en API's (AWS Serverless, microservices) met een focus op clean code.

  • Vertalen van complexe klantvragen naar stabiele cloud-infrastructuren en dit helder uitleggen aan zowel developers als aan de klant.

  • Proactief bewaken en optimaliseren van applicatie-uptime, API-performance, databeveiliging en cloud-kosten (FinOps).

  • Reviewen van code, bewaken van de technische standaard en het coachen van andere developers binnen het team.

  • Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.

Requirements

Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een ervaren engineer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau en meerdere jaren ervaring in het succesvol bouwen van grootschalige, complexe cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt al meters gemaakt met AWS en weet hoe je een stabiele infrastructuur ontwerpt voor mobiele toepassingen (zoals iOS en Android). Modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.

Je bent een echte spin in de code die geniet van architectonische puzzels en kalm blijft tijdens kritieke live-gang momenten. Je streeft onvoorwaardelijk naar technisch vakmanschap en deelt jouw kennis graag om het hele team naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je begrijpt dat het in deze rol draait om de perfecte brug te slaan tussen de wensen van de klant en de ultieme technische oplossing. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, RTL Boulevard en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper).

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

raw.description:
Summary

The VP, Global Practices leads the technical and methodological backbone of Guidewire Professional Services. This leader owns the global capability, technical standards, and innovation agenda across five practices — InsuranceSuite & INOW, Data, Digital, Tech & Integration, and Business Consulting — and is accountable for ensuring Guidewire-led implementations and SI partner-led programs are delivered to the highest technical bar in the industry.

This role is a true VP on all three Guidewire PS VP framework dimensions: global in scope (every practice, every region, every product), strategy-setting in authority (defines the multi-year capability roadmap and the technical bar for Guidewire implementations worldwide), and externally facing (the senior technical voice of PS with customers, SI partners, analysts, and industry forums).

Job Description

What you’ll do

Strategic Accountabilities

Technical Methodology and Standards

  • Own deployment of global technical methodology — architecture standards, integration patterns, product-specific implementation methods, design patterns, and code standards — for every Guidewire product implemented through PS.

  • Maintain practice IP (toolkits, accelerators, reference architectures) in partnership with Services Product and Portfolio team, and ensure it is versioned, governed, and accessible to regions, GDC, and SI partners globally.

  • Set the engineering rigor expected of every implementation, every region, and every partner; establish the quality bar and the enforcement mechanisms that hold to it.

  • Partner with Delivery Assurance & Global PMO on integration into the end-to-end PS delivery standard, and with Global Delivery on operationalizing technical methodology into GDC and productized services.

Innovation and Practice Evolution

  • Set the multi-year vision for how each of the five practices evolves to support new products (Pricing & Rating, Underwriting, Industry Intelligence), new delivery models, and AI-accelerated implementation.

  • Lead the integration of AI methods and tools into technical practice methodology — AI-accelerated prototyping, document ingestion, intelligent automation, code-gen, and agentic workflows — in partnership with the PS AI CoE.

  • Partner with Product, Platform, and AI engineering to ensure practice capability stays ahead of product roadmap commitments — and that Guidewire-led implementations are a proof point for new product capability.

  • Champion the productization of repeatable services solutions (e.g., BOLT, US Admitted Lines) and own the technical quality of those offerings in partnership with Global Delivery and Product & Portfolio.

Talent and Capability Bench

  • Build and maintain a world-class bench of architects, technical experts, and methodologists across all five practices.

  • Define the technical career path and leveling expectations for practice talent — from senior consultant to principal architect — in partnership with People Solutions on the broader PS career framework.

  • Drive workforce planning across practices in coordination with Global Operations and Global Delivery — anticipating skill needs 12–24 months ahead of demand.

  • Drive high levels of utilization and overall productivity across practices, managing the impacts of AI on the various tasks and roles in the organization.

  • Develop succession depth for each Senior Director practice lead and identify high-potential talent for cross-practice rotation.

Sales and Strategic Deal Support

  • Serve as the senior technical voice on strategic deals — partner with GTM and regions on deal shaping, technical pre-sales, and complex proposal development.

  • Provide escalation support for at-risk programs, bringing the right practice expertise to recover delivery and protect customer outcomes.

  • Own the technical credibility of Professional Services with major customers, partners, and Guidewire executive leadership.

Partner Technical Enablement

  • Partner with Delivery Assurance & Global PMO (which owns partner program quality standards) to set the technical bar that SI partners must meet to deliver Guidewire programs successfully, and align technical certification with overall partner accreditation.

  • Build the practice tools, training, and reference assets that enable SI partners to scale quality delivery without Guidewire bottlenecks.

  • Influence the partner ecosystem strategy — which partners to invest in, where capability gaps exist, and how to close them.

Practice Areas Under Leadership

Five Senior Director-led practices, each with its own strategic mandate:

  • InsuranceSuite & INOW — global product methodology, architecture standards, and integration patterns for Guidewire's flagship core product suite.

  • Data — data architecture, platform integration, ETL, analytics enablement, and Industry Intelligence implementation methodology.

  • Digital — Jutro, digital experience layer, customer and agent portals, and modern front-end engineering practices.

  • Tech & Integration — integration architecture, API design, cloud platform engineering, DevOps, and the cross-cutting technical foundation that all practices depend on.

  • Business Consulting — insurance domain expertise, business process design, change management, and value realization advisory.

External Representation

Represents Guidewire externally as the senior technical voice of Professional Services — at customer executive briefings, customer advisory councils, SI partner technical summits, analyst engagements, and industry forums. The role is the public face of “how Guidewire implements”, with credibility to engage architects and engineers as a peer, not just a manager.

Decision Rights

  • Owns: Global technical methodology, reference architectures, architecture and integration standards, practice IP (toolkits, accelerators, design patterns, code standards), engineering quality bar for implementations, technical certification standard for SI partners, technical career path and leveling for practice talent, practice headcount plan.

  • Influences: Regional delivery execution (regions own customer P&L), program management and assurance methodology (owned by Delivery Assurance & Global PMO), engineering and delivery-execution methodology for GDC and productized services (owned by Global Delivery), product roadmap (owned by Product & Engineering), AI tooling roadmap (owned by AI CoE), partner commercial strategy (owned by GTM and Alliances).

What Success Looks Like in the First 12-18 Months

  • Each practice has a refreshed, multi-year capability roadmap aligned to Guidewire's product strategy and AI direction.

  • Measurable improvement in implementation quality and consistency — fewer escalations, more predictable technical outcomes, fewer rework cycles.

  • AI-accelerated methods are integrated into core technical practices and produce demonstrable productivity gains as well as measurable returns – in speed, accuracy, and cost-efficiency to both Customers and Guidewire.

  • The SI partner ecosystem is operating to a clearer, more rigorous technical bar with defined accreditation.

  • Senior Director practice leads are operating with greater autonomy and have credible succession plans in place.

  • Regions and customers experience Global Practices as a force multiplier — not a bottleneck.

What you’ll bring

Required experience

  • 15+ years in technology services, software implementation, or enterprise consulting, with significant time in a practice or capability leadership role.

  • Proven track record leading a global, multi-practice or multi-discipline technical organization at scale.

  • Deep experience implementing complex enterprise software — ideally in insurance, financial services, or a comparable regulated industry.

  • Demonstrated experience driving technical methodology and engineering rigor in cloud-based delivery models.

  • Experience integrating AI and automation into delivery practices — agentic tooling, code-gen, document ingestion, intelligent automation.

  • Experience operating in or alongside a major SI partner ecosystem.

Required capabilities

  • Strategy-setting leadership: defines a multi-year technical vision for a global function — anticipates market and technology shifts and translates them into clear capability priorities.

  • Stakeholder influence: builds alignment across executives, regions, partners, and customers — solves for the enterprise rather than for a single function.

  • Technical credibility with senior architects and engineers — engages as a peer, not just a manager.

  • Talent architecture: builds future-ready leaders and capability; leads transformations in skills, methodology, and ways of working.

  • Executive presence: communicates with clarity, confidence, and credibility across cultures and audiences; able to represent Guidewire externally at the highest levels.

Preferred

  • P&C insurance domain depth, or comparable depth in another core-systems-driven regulated industry.

  • Prior CTO, Chief Architect, or VP of Engineering experience in a services or product company.

  • Track record building or scaling a global practice function from earlier-stage to enterprise scale.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $232,000 - $377,000. Your base pay will depend on your experience, skills, education, training, and location among other factors. About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. Build the German market. Win new business. Own the opportunity.

The business is building innovative solutions across healthcare and international talent mobility, with a growing presence across international markets.

It’s a genuinely varied role where you can take ownership of the full sales journey and make a real impact as the business continues to grow in Germany.

You’ll play a key role in establishing and growing our Client’s business across the German market, combining outbound business development, consultative selling, opportunity management and account growth.

You’ll work with senior decision-makers across nursing schools, vocational training providers, recognition examination preparation organisations and education institutions, building relationships and creating new commercial opportunities.

  • Generating new business opportunities across Germany and the wider DACH market.
  • Researching and engaging senior decision-makers within nursing schools, training providers and education organisations.
  • Managing opportunities through the sales cycle, from initial conversation and qualification through to proposal and close.
  • Building strong relationships with new and existing customers.
  • Identifying opportunities to expand existing accounts and increase customer value.
  • Managing RFQs, tenders and commercial proposals.
  • Delivering engaging online product demonstrations and presentations.
  • Attending customer meetings, industry events and other face-to-face opportunities across Germany when required.
  • Maintaining an accurate sales pipeline and CRM records.
  • Working with internal teams and client stakeholders to maximise commercial opportunities.
  • Consistently achieving and exceeding sales targets and KPIs.

We’re looking for a commercially driven salesperson who enjoys opening doors, building relationships and taking ownership of opportunities within the education and training sector.

Essential

  • Native or fluent German speaker with excellent English communication skills.
  • Currently living in Germany / DACH region.
  • Comfortable working remotely while travelling occasionally for customer meetings and events when required.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience selling into, and networking within, the German education, vocational training or professional training sector is essential.

From time to time, you’ll attend industry events, customer meetings and networking opportunities across Germany, giving you the chance to build your network, meet customers face-to-face and represent an innovative proposition.

You’ll have the opportunity to own conversations, develop opportunities, close business and grow customer relationships, giving you broader exposure than a traditional Inside Sales position.

If you’re a German-speaking B2B sales professional with experience in the education or training sector who loves winning new business, closing opportunities and building long-term customer relationships, this could be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

Specifically, you will support the sales team with full sales lifecycle management through strategic account planning, research, opportunity management, relationship-building, partnering with services teams and OEM vendors, pursuit, and closure.

What you will do:

  • Develop and execute successful strategies that expand CDW Security’s customer base and achieve bookings, revenue, and gross profit targets.
  • Establish a detailed, comprehensive understanding of all capabilities, service offerings, value proposition, market positioning, selling strategy and process, as well as key differentiators.
  • Cultivate productive relationships with key personnel in current and targeted accounts.
  • Identify, engage, qualify, develop, and earn new clients.
  • Manage, support, and grow relationships as part of the extended sales team with prospects and clients as a consultative seller.
  • Network with a broad range of client organizations and leadership in key fields, including: Information Technology, Information Security, Finance, Internal Audit, Data Privacy, Compliance, and Legal, Enterprise Risk Management, Procurement / Supply Chain Management.
  • Proactively coordinate with other CDW Security resources to drive sales cycles, meet company objectives, and exceed client expectations. These key internal resources include Subject Matter Experts, Practice Leadership, Sales Management and Marketing.
  • Build strong relationships with the partner community to identify opportunities for CDW and those partners.
  • Understand industry landscapes and follow trends that impact our clients’ business risk, strategic decision-making, and budget planning and expenditure.
  • Provide accurate sales pipeline updates and forecasts.
  • Proactively populate and maintain all information in Salesforce.
  • Provide onboarding support and mentorship to entry level Security Solutions Executives.
  • Enhance CDW Security’s and your personal brand through participation at industry events, speaking engagements, blogging and other forms of acceptable public communication.
  • Proactively work with marketing to develop regional events that attract senior leadership from key accounts and prospects.

What we expect of you:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, or related technical degree or equivalent.
  • 10+ years of experience identifying opportunities and full lifecycle management for security services and products and/or equivalent experience as a security practitioner.
  • Mastery of at least seven of the security focus areas in the security portfolio: Identity and Access Management, Security Program Development Privacy, Risk and Compliance, Third-Party Risk Management, Threat and Vulnerability Management, Cyber Workforce Development, Cloud Security, Secure Infrastructure, Physical Security, Emerging Security Technologies.
  • Experience with enterprise sales, with both strategic planning and day-to-day execution.
  • Proven performance record with demonstrated year-over-year metrics.
  • Successful record of meeting or exceeding sales goals.
  • Ability to take personal ownership of professional goals and achieve financial targets.
  • Strong ambition and sense of urgency.
  • Energetic networker and relationship-builder.
  • Ability to work with and effectively coordinate across extended internal teams and partners.
  • Excellent, professional written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to travel as needed for customer meetings and to develop/maintain partner relationships.

Pay range: $ 100,000 - $140,000, depending on experience and skill set. Annual bonus target of $30,000 plus 12% commission on GP services sales, subject to terms and conditions of plan. Benefits overview:

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

raw.excerpt: ABOUT GREYSTAR Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing.
raw.description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Enablement Coordinator is responsible for supporting successful onboarding and adoption of procurement software and processes for new communities, business units, regions, and lines of business. The Coordinator provides hands-on support during initial buildout and for up to 90 days post-onboarding, troubleshooting, and guidance to internal stakeholders.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Onboarding & Adoption

  • Support successful onboarding and adoption of procurement software and processes for new communities, business units, regions, and lines of business.
  • Provide hands-on support during initial buildout and for up to 90 days post-onboarding, troubleshooting, and guidance to onboarding communities and internal team members.
  • Audit new supplier records for accuracy and completeness and integrate suppliers into the Greystar supplier environment in accordance with procurement standards.
  • Assist with onboarding and testing new software and functionality prior to rollout.

Standardization & Compliance

  • Identify opportunities to standardize onboarding processes and support compliance through procurement software.
  • Strengthen alignment with organizational standards across onboarding engagements.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Assist by partnering closely with Operations and Software Support teams to maintain process integrity throughout onboarding.
  • Collaborate with PTP to ensure a seamless client experience across the Source-to-Settle lifecycle.

BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • 1–3 years of experience in client/site/community onboarding, implementation, or training/enablement roles.
  • Working knowledge of procurement processes and software adoption practices.
  • Experience assisting with training and support delivery to onboarding communities and internal team members.
  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field, or equivalent professional experience.

SPECIALIZED SKILLS

  • Ability to assist with training and enablement delivery.
  • Customer service orientation toward communities and internal stakeholders.
  • Comfortable coordinating multiple concurrent onboarding engagements.
  • Collaborative, cross-functional mindset.

The hourly range for this position is $22.60 - $26.95.


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage; costs discounted after 3 and 5 years of service.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.
  • 6-Week Paid Sabbatical after 10 years of service (and every 5 years thereafter).
  • 401(k) with Company Match up to 6% of pay after 6 months of service.
  • Paid Parental Leave and lifetime Fertility Benefit reimbursement up to $10,000 (includes adoption or surrogacy).
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Legal Plans.
  • Charitable giving program and benefits.

*Benefits offered for full-time employees. For Union and Prevailing Wage roles, compensation and benefits may vary from the listed information above due to Collective Bargaining Agreements and/or local governing authority.


Greystar will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Greystar is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


This position may be performed remotely anywhere within the United States except the state of Alaska.


Important Notice: Greystar will never request your banking details or other sensitive personal information during the interview process. Greystar does not conduct any interviews via text or messaging, and all communication will come from official Greystar email addresses (@greystar.com). If you receive suspicious requests, please report them immediately to .

October 21, 2026

This date may be subject to change due to evolving business needs.

raw.description:
As Group IT Manager, reporting to the Head of IT and working closely with the Head of UK and Global IT Cybersecurity Consultant, you will oversee the global governance, delivery, and optimisation of the organisation’s IT platforms and services.
Working within a cloud-first, Azure-led environment, you will lead the design, standardisation, and continuous improvement of technologies including Azure, Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, endpoint management, and cloud infrastructure.
You will ensure a seamless and secure digital workplace experience across all locations, with responsibility for platform governance, IT operations, identity and access management, endpoint governance, and service delivery within a globally standardised Azure environment.
The role also focuses on maintaining a globally aligned IT operating model, providing strategic direction and ensuring effective execution through regional IT teams, while ensuring platforms remain scalable, secure, resilient, and compliant with business and regulatory requirements.

We welcome applications from candidates who prefer to work fully office-based, in a hybrid arrangement, or fully remote from a Langham Hall country location. Successful hire would be required to work within the European time zone. Applications welcome from candidates whose working locations are based in United Kingdon, Ireland, New York, Guernsey, Jersey and Luxembourg only.

Key Responsibilities


Global Platform Ownership & Operations
  • Own and govern the global Azure environment, ensuring performance, scalability, security, resilience, and cost optimisation.
  • Lead Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) globally, including architecture, operational standards, scaling, performance, and user experience.
  • Define and enforce standards across Microsoft 365, Azure services, and core cloud platforms.
  • Act as escalation point for critical platform issues, ensuring stability and availability.
  • Drive automation, standardisation, monitoring, and continuous service improvement.

Digital Workplace & Office Technology
  • Own IT services across all global offices, ensuring a consistent digital workplace experience.
  • Define standards for collaboration tools, Microsoft Teams, conferencing systems, and meeting room technologies.
  • Ensure alignment between global standards and regional execution.
  • Improve IT service quality, responsiveness, and end-user experience globally.
Endpoint & Device Management
  • Own global endpoint management via Microsoft Intune and Autopilot.
  • Define device lifecycle standards including provisioning, configuration, patching, compliance, asset management, and retirement.
  • Ensure all endpoints meet security, compliance, and Conditional Access requirements.
  • Maintain global visibility and governance of all devices.
Identity & Access Management
  • Own Entra ID operations including identity lifecycle, access control, governance, and access reviews. Enforce Zero Trust principles, MFA, Conditional Access, least privilege, and role-based access.
  • Improve privileged access management and identity security structures.
  • Ensure compliance with audit, regulatory, and client requirements.

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Own global joiner, mover, and leaver processes.
  • Ensure secure provisioning and deprovisioning across Entra ID, Intune, AVD, Microsoft 365, and business systems.
  • Maintain audit-ready compliance and a consistent employee experience.


Security, Risk & Incident Response
  • Own and govern security controls across all core IT platforms.
  • Ensure alignment with cybersecurity frameworks, ISO 27001, ISAE 3402, DORA, and client assurance requirements.
  • Lead or support major security incidents across platforms and regions.
  • Support audits, risk assessments, control testing, and remediation tracking.
  • Drive a strong global security culture.

Resilience, Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

  • Own global disaster recovery and resilience strategy for cloud and IT services.
  • Ensure redundancy, failover, backup validation, and cross-region continuity. Lead DR testing, validation, and remediation activities.
  • Align IT resilience with business continuity requirements.
Network & Connectivity
  • Define global connectivity standards for Azure, Microsoft 365, AVD, and SaaS platforms.
  • Oversee secure network design including VPN, WiFi, wired networks, and cloud connectivity.
  • Manage global network providers and ensure service performance and reliability.
  • Resolve connectivity issues impacting core platforms.
Governance, Compliance & Vendor Management
  • Own IT governance frameworks, policies, and standards globally.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 27001, ISAE 3402, and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead audit, risk, and compliance reporting activities.
  • Manage strategic vendor relationships, ensuring performance, cost optimisation, and service quality.

Global Leadership & Operating Model
  • Lead a federated global IT operating model across central and regional teams.
  • Provide technical direction and governance to regional IT teams across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Ensure consistent service delivery, tooling, and standards globally.
  • Lead global IT initiatives from strategy through to operational adoption.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Strategy & Continuous Improvement
  • Translate business requirements into global IT strategy and roadmap.
  • Drive standardisation, automation, optimisation, and simplification of IT services.
  • Ensure technology decisions align with security, compliance, and business objectives.
  • Balance strategic leadership with operational execution.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Strong experience in Microsoft Azure environments (governance, security, networking, cost management, resilience).
  • Enterprise experience with Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) including scaling, performance, and user experience optimisation.
  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, and modern endpoint management.
  • Strong expertise in Entra ID, identity governance, Conditional Access, MFA, Zero Trust, and least privilege models.
  • Experience managing Microsoft 365 at enterprise scale.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, VPN, WiFi, secure access, and hybrid connectivity.
  • Experience with cloud disaster recovery, resilience, and business continuity frameworks.
  • Experience operating across multi-region or global IT environments.
  • Experience in regulated environments with audit, risk, compliance, and client assurance requirements.
  • Familiarity with ISO 27001, ISAE 3402, DORA, and cybersecurity control frameworks.
  • Minimum 10 years’ IT experience, including operational and leadership responsibilities.

Preferred Attributes

  • Proven experience leading distributed or global IT teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management with senior leadership engagement.
  • Strategic thinker with ability to balance governance and execution.
  • Strong focus on global consistency and user experience.
  • Highly structured approach to governance, control, and service quality.
  • Proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail, documentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborative leadership style with ability to influence across regions and vendors.

raw.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for Android software engineers to build the native Android experience for Doit's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is based in Taiwan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Taiwan office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for mobile developers to build BJAK's AI Neobank App across Android and iOS.

This role is for strong mobile builders who can ship clean, reliable and intuitive mobile experiences, whether their main strength is Android, iOS or both.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship mobile features for Android and/or iOS.

  • Create simple mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product, design and backend teams to turn complex journeys into usable mobile products.

  • Integrate APIs and handle edge cases, loading states, errors and production issues.

  • Improve app performance, reliability, crash rate and user experience.

  • Support fast product launches, experiments and iterations across mobile journeys.

  • Help set high standards for mobile product quality across the app.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.

  • Strong experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • Experience shipping production apps used by real users.

  • Strong product sense and attention to mobile UX.

  • Able to work with APIs, analytics, crash logs and production feedback.

  • Fast, practical and comfortable owning work with limited handholding.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks like a product builder, not just a mobile coder.

  • Cares about smooth flows, small details and real user behaviour.

  • Can work across ambiguity and ship without waiting for perfect specs.

  • Takes production quality personally.

  • Honest about what they built directly versus what the wider team delivered.

This Role Is Not For

  • Developers who only want to build isolated screens.

  • People who do not care about UX, performance or reliability.

  • Candidates who cannot explain their own contribution clearly.

  • People who need heavy guidance for every task.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a high-growth environment.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Sweden. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Sweden.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
